package day1;

public class Program_ASCII {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
char big='A';
int bet=big;

char small='a';
int bet1=small;

char marks='0';
int marked=marks;

char special='@';
int specialized=special;

System.out.println("ASCII value of A"+" "+"="+" "+bet);
System.out.println("ASCII value of a"+" "+"="+" "+bet1);
System.out.println("ASCII value of 0"+" "+"="+" "+marked);
System.out.println("ASCII value of @"+" "+"="+" "+specialized);
	}

}
